title.zh: 将保和省Talibon市镇Carlos P. Garcia总统省立医院床位由75张增至100张，将该院迁至保和省Talibon San Jose，并为此拨款的法案
title.en: An Act Increasing the Bed Capacity of the Pres. Carlos P. Garcia Provincial Hospital in the Municipality of Talibon, Province of Bohol, From Seventy-five (75) To One Hundred (100) Beds, and Relocating the Said Hospital in San Jose, Talibon, Bohol, and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Increasing the Bed Capacity of the Pres. Carlos P. Garcia Provincial Hospital in the Municipality of Talibon, Province of Bohol, From Seventy-five (75) To One Hundred (100) Beds, and Relocating the Said Hospital in San Jose, Talibon, Bohol, and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.vi: Đạo luật tăng sức chứa giường bệnh của Bệnh viện Tỉnh Pres. Carlos P. Garcia tại Đô thị Talibon, Tỉnh Bohol từ 75 lên 100 giường, và phân bổ kinh phí
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเพิ่มจำนวนเตียงของโรงพยาบาลจังหวัด Pres. Carlos P. Garcia ในเทศบาล Talibon จังหวัด Bohol จาก 75 เป็น 100 เตียง และจัดสรรงบประมาณ
title.id: Undang-Undang meningkatkan kapasitas tempat tidur Rumah Sakit Provinsi Pres. Carlos P. Garcia di Kotamadya Talibon, Provinsi Bohol dari 75 menjadi 100 tempat tidur, dan mengalokasikan dana
title.ms: Akta meningkatkan kapasiti katil Hospital Wilayah Pres. Carlos P. Garcia di Perbandaran Talibon, Wilayah Bohol daripada 75 kepada 100 katil, serta memperuntukkan dana

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1992/ra_7483_1992.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The bed capacity of the Pres. Carlos P. Garcia Provincial Hospital in the Municipality of Talibon, Province of Bohol, is hereby increased from seventy-five (75) to one hundred (100) beds, and relocating the said hospital in San Jose, Talibon, Bohol.
The amount necessary to carry out the provisions of this Act shall be included in the General Appropriations Act of the year following its enactment into law and thereafter.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
